title: Experts say the new Democratic congressional majority will likely seek to rebuild CISA, prioritize AI security, revive local cyber grants, probe DOGE, and more (Eric Geller/Cybersecurity Dive)
summary: Eric Geller / Cybersecurity Dive: Experts say the new Democratic congressional majority will likely seek to rebuild CISA, prioritize AI security, revive local cyber grants, probe DOGE, and more — From CISA to AI and beyond, the new Democratic majority has many opportunities to scrutinize government programs and push new policies.
